newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Avon Products raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Avon Products raised.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Brenda Landry said she upgraded Avon Products Inc to outperform from neutral.

-- "I have finally become a believer. In late 1993 the company began to refocus itself and given all the machinations, I wasn't sure if they would stay on focus on the direct selling of beauty (products). Well, they have retained their focus and a lot of things," Landry said.

-- "Essentially the most obvious (plus) is the (sales) rep count. For the September quarter it was the third quarter in a row (that the sales rep count) was up. Direct selling is a matter of hiring bodies," she added.
-- "In Europe it's pretty much made its shift from fixed costs to variable costs. The one major problem is Japan."
-- The analyst set a 12-month price target of $60 on the stock.
